core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ansaar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Helpers”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ansaar corresponds to the Arabic form أنصار (Arabic root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r); أَنْصَار (ʾanṣār)). Its core sense is helpers. Ansaar is Arabic أَنْصَار (ʾanṣār) 'Helpers', the broken plural of the active participle of نَصَرَ (naṣara, 'to help') from the root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r). Ansaar is a variant romanization of Ansar.

etymology.morphology: Broken plural (afʿāl pattern) of the active participle of نَصَرَ (naṣara, 'to help'), built on the root ن ص ر.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form أنصار is an established Arabic lexical item — the plural of the helper form of the root ن ص ر — and Ansaar is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

language_notes.primary: Arabic is the language of the recorded form أنصار.
language_notes.usage: Other scripts are transliterations of the name into those writing systems; they are not independent origins.

origin.origin_explanation: The name originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming through established multilingual use.

religion.religious_status: Culturally used; not inherently a doctrinal term
religion.religious_explanation: Ansaar is used by Muslims as a personal name, but the word itself is lexical in origin; its Islamic association is cultural rather than scriptural.

quranic_status.note: Ansaar is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name, so no Qur'anic basis is claimed.

islamic_naming_context.interpretation: Its lexical sense is a positive quality that families may wish for a child.
islamic_naming_context.important_distinction: Muslim use of the name is not evidence that the word is Qur'anic or religiously prescribed.

persian.name: أنصار
persian.long_meaning: Ansaar (أنصار) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن انصار، یاوران پیامبر است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: अंसार
hindi.long_meaning: Ansaar (अंसार) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ अंसार, पैग़ंबर के सहायक है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: انصار
pashto.long_meaning: Ansaar (انصار) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې انصار، د پیغمبر مرستیالان ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: أنصار
arabic.long_meaning: Ansaar (أنصار) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الأنصار، أنصار النبي. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
